join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!admin sleep
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=super-admin :!admin sleep
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !admin sleep <dur>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=super-admin :!admin sleep what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !admin sleep <dur>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=super-admin :!admin sleep 10ms
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Slept for 10ms.
